sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is closest to B. prabhae, but in this species the posterior part of the head capsule bears 2 long setae, whereas B. prabhae is hairless; the antennae of this species have 13—14 segments, and when 14-segmented segment 3 is shorter than segment 4, whereas the antennae of B. prabhae have 14 segments with segment 3 longer than segment 4; in this species there are no minute teeth beneath the apical process of the right mandible, whereas B. prabhae has them. Compared with B. parapusillus, the latter has head length including rostrum 1.17—1.52 mm, head length excluding rostrum 0.78—1.08 mm, head width 0.67—0.88 mm and rostrum length 0.53—0.60 mm, all smaller than in this species; its antennae have only 13 segments and its workers are monomorphic with antennae of only 14 segments, whereas this species has 13—14 antennal segments and dimorphic workers with 14—15 segments. Compared with B. pyriformis, the latter has head length including rostrum 1.28—1.59 mm, head length excluding rostrum 0.78—0.98 mm and head width 0.64—0.85 mm, both limits smaller than in this species, and antennae with 12—13 segments, and the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum are without incisions, whereas in this species they are faintly incised. Compared with B. bulbiceps, the soldier of the latter is smaller (body length 2.90—3.15 mm), with antennae of only 12 segments, a shorter rostrum (0.42—0.46 mm) and mandibles without an apical process; its head length including rostrum is 1.10—1.26 mm, head width at the constriction 0.43—0.48 mm, head height 0.46—0.54 mm, ratio of head width at the constriction to head width 0.58—0.60, postmentum length 0.18—0.21 mm, postmentum width 0.24—0.26 mm, pronotum width 0.30—0.34 mm and length 0.11—0.12 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldiers monomorphic. Head capsule pear-shaped, without a rostrum, slightly constricted behind the antennae. Head capsule brown to rusty brown over the middle and posterior parts and dark smoky brown over the anterior part and the posterolateral ends; in dorsal view slightly concave and somewhat depressed behind the rostrum, the posterior margin arcuately convex, the posterior part of the head capsule with 2 long setae. Frontal gland and its duct visible. Rostrum cylindrical, darker than the head capsule, red-brown at the base and dark red-brown apically, the tip slightly transparent and bearing 4 long setae; its length usually exceeds half the head length (excluding rostrum), and is sometimes less than or equal to 3/4 of the head length (excluding rostrum). Mandibles reduced, with a prominent slender apical process whose length varies slightly between individuals; right mandible without minute teeth. Antennae usually 14-segmented (sometimes 13), yellow-brown to brown, the segments unequal in length: with 13 segments segment 2 is the shortest, segment 3 is twice as long as segment 2 and longer than segments 4 and 5, and segment 5 is longer than segment 4; with 14 segments segment 2 is the shortest or equal in length to segment 3, and segment 4 is longer than segment 3 (sometimes segment 3 is longer than segment 4). Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior and posterior margins faintly incised, pale brown to brown, the anterior lobe darker than the posterior lobe, the anterior margin with microscopic setae. Legs pale brown to straw-coloured. Abdominal tergites pale brown, long setae present only on the posterior tergites; sternites yellow-brown, with long and short setae. Measurements (holotype/range, n=18): body length 3.69/3.14—4.70 mm, head length including rostrum 1.60/1.51—2.00 mm, head length excluding rostrum 0.93/0.87—1.25 mm, head width 0.85/0.75—1.22 mm, ratio of head width to head length (excluding rostrum) 0.91/0.86—0.98, rostrum length 0.67/0.61—0.80 mm, ratio of rostrum length to head length (excluding rostrum) 0.72/0.55—0.78, head width at the constriction 0.58/0.57—0.69 mm, ratio of head width at the constriction to head width 0.68/0.58—0.78, head height 0.66/0.55—0.81 mm, pronotum length 0.22/0.18—0.28 mm and width 0.46/0.42—0.55 mm, postmentum length 0.35/0.27—0.35 mm and width 0.31/0.28—0.36 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers dimorphic. Major worker: head subquadrate, pale brown with a yellowish tinge to dark brown, rather densely hairy; frontal sutures distinctly Y-shaped; fontanelle plate prominent, oval; postclypeus inflated and hairy, divided by a median suture into two equal halves, its length less than half its width. Antennae pale yellow to pale yellow-brown, 14—15 segmented: with 14 segments segment 4 is the shortest and segment 2 is equal in length to or longer than segment 3; with 15 segments segment 3 is the shortest or equal in length to segment 4, and segment 2 is longer than or equal to segment 4. Left mandible with an apical tooth and 3 marginal teeth, the posterior margin of marginal tooth 1 slightly undulate, marginal teeth 2 and 3 small but distinct, marginal tooth 3 slightly longer than marginal tooth 2 and separated from the molar prominence by a broad U-shaped notch, the molar plate with 4 distinct ridges; right mandible with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth and marginal tooth 1 both slightly broader than those of the left mandible and forming an obtuse angle, marginal tooth 2 small with a blunt tip and an almost straight posterior margin, the molar plate with 10 distinct ridges, the inner layer poorly developed and the proximal notch weak. Thorax pale yellow; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin faintly incised and the posterior margin without a distinct incision, pale brown to brown and lighter than the head, the anterior lobe darker than the posterior lobe, the anterior margin with microscopic setae and 2 long setae on each side. Legs straw-coloured. Abdominal tergites pale brown, long setae present only on the posterior tergites; sternites yellow-brown, with long and short setae. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller in body; antennae with only 14 segments, segment 4 the shortest, segment 2 equal in length to or longer than segment 3; mandibles with an apical tooth and 2—3 marginal teeth, all smaller than in the major worker, the apical tooth and marginal tooth 1 less acute than in the latter; left mandible with a distinct apical tooth and 3 marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly shorter than marginal tooth 1 and forming an acute angle with it, the posterior margin of marginal tooth 1 slightly undulate, marginal teeth 2 and 3 small but distinct, marginal tooth 2 broader than in the major worker, marginal tooth 3 slightly longer than marginal tooth 2 and separated from the molar prominence by a V-shaped notch, the molar plate with 4 ridges; right mandible with the apical tooth shorter and sharper than marginal tooth 1 and forming an obtuse angle with it, marginal tooth 2 small with a blunt tip and an almost straight posterior margin, the molar plate with 6 ridges. Measurements (major worker n=5/minor worker n=2): body length 3.20—5.90/2.65—2.78 mm, head length 0.87—1.25/0.68—0.74 mm, head width 1.04—1.40/0.74—0.81 mm, pronotum length 0.21—0.43/0.18—0.27 mm and width 0.51—0.77/0.41—0.44 mm, postclypeus length 0.20—0.25/0.18—0.20 mm and width 0.50—0.60/0.38—0.40 mm.

note: Adapted from the new-species description in Das & Choudhury (2023), original in English; the alate is not described (Imago: Unknown in the original); figure numbers (Figs 1—28), holotype and paratype localities, ecology and distribution records are not translated.
